Hi Team,

We are running **OLake v0.6.7** and nedd <#C081MV728N7> on a character encoding issue where non-recoverable `0x9D` (`U+009D` control character / mojibake) bytes appear in our Parquet files ingested from a source MariaDB database.

This is impacting multiple string fields (containing accented characters, smart/curly quotes, and apostrophes) across both our Dev and Prod pipelines (snapshot and CDC).

1. Does the OLake MariaDB connector enforce strict UTF-8 decoding during binlog/snapshot extraction, or is there a way to preserve/configure source character set handling (e.g. `latin1` / `Windows-1252`)?
2. In v0.6.7, is there any known behavior or configuration during Parquet serialization that could introduce `0x9D` (`C29D` in UTF-8) byte sequences when handling non-ASCII characters?

Are these issues addressed in latest versions?

hey <@U0C1QPWD94G>,
Could you please share the following from the affected MariaDB setup?
1. DB version: `SELECT VERSION();`
2. Column charset/collation:
```SELECT COLUMN_NAME, CHARACTER_SET_NAME, COLLATION_NAME
FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='<db>' AND TABLE_NAME='<table>';```
3. For one affected row:
```SELECT HEX(col), HEX(CONVERT(BINARY(col) USING utf8mb4))
FROM <table> WHERE <pk>=<id>;```
4. The OLake connector image/tag you're using as there is no olake v0.6.7 exist

Hi team,
I have one question, I have full load + cdc pipelines setup from my RDS MySQL to Iceberg. It's working on binlogs, I want to rename my RDS instance which means mysql host name changes in Olake Source configuration.
It's just the hostname change on same DB, same binlog files nothing changes there so my question is will my CDC pipelines keep working and pick from last CDC point after I change my hostname or will it do a full load again or something I should take care of before doing this

elements.text:
Hi team,
I have one question, I have full load + cdc pipelines setup from my RDS MySQL to Iceberg. It's working on binlogs, I want to rename my RDS instance which means mysql host name changes in Olake Source configuration.
It's just the hostname change on same DB, same binlog files nothing changes there so my question is will my CDC pipelines keep working and pick from last CDC point after I change my hostname or will it do a full load again or something I should take care of before doing this

text:
<@U0A5EGHRLQY> Yes, your CDC pipelines will keep working and resume from the last CDC checkpoint after the hostname change. No full load will be triggered. OLake stores the CDC checkpoint as the binlog file name and position (plus a replication server ID). It does not store the hostname.

The host is only used to open the connection, so once you update it in the Source config, the next sync connects to the new endpoint and continues from the saved binlog position.
